perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

enhanced.name: Impulse Amplifier
enhanced.description: Massively increases projectile velocity, substantially increases reload speed.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.description: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

enhanced.name: Danger Zone
enhanced.description:
The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.
Base blast radius is also improved.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

enhanced.name: Blast Distributor
enhanced.description: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

enhanced.name: Wellspring
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Harmony
enhanced.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for an improved duration.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Surrounded
enhanced.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

enhanced.name: Paracausal Affinity
enhanced.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for an improved duration. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

perks.name: Full Court
perks.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels further before exploding.

enhanced.name: Full Court
enhanced.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels farther before exploding. Increases blast radius.

perks.name: Bait and Switch
perks.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost.

enhanced.name: Bait and Switch
enhanced.description: Deal damage with all equipped weapons within a short time to give this weapon a damage boost for an improved duration.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

enhanced.name: Chaos Reshaped
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

flavor: "I cannot sleep. His gaze… it lingers at every corner of my mind." —Koraxis, Acolyte of Nezarec
